dentalSurgery.heroTitle: Precision Dental Surgery You Can Trust
dentalSurgery.heroSubtitle: Advanced surgical procedures performed by board-certified specialists using the latest technology for safe, comfortable outcomes.
dentalSurgery.servicesSubtitle: From simple extractions to complex reconstructions, our surgical team handles every case with precision.
dentalSurgery.s1Desc: Painless removal of damaged, impacted, or wisdom teeth using minimally invasive techniques.
dentalSurgery.s2Desc: Rebuild jawbone structure to support implants or restore facial contours with natural-looking results.
dentalSurgery.s3Desc: Emergency surgical care available the same day. No long waits when you need treatment most.
dentalSurgery.s4Desc: Certified oral and maxillofacial surgeons with decades of combined surgical experience.
dentalSurgery.step1Desc: Comprehensive exam and 3D imaging to plan your surgical treatment.
dentalSurgery.step2Desc: Full health screening and personalised anaesthesia plan for your comfort.
dentalSurgery.step3Desc: Expert surgery in our state-of-the-art theatre with real-time monitoring.
dentalSurgery.step4Desc: Dedicated aftercare team and 24/7 support throughout your healing journey.
dentalSurgery.faq1A: Modern anaesthesia ensures you feel little to no discomfort during the procedure. Post-op pain is managed with prescribed medication.
dentalSurgery.faq2A: Most patients resume normal activities within 3–5 days. Full healing typically takes 2–4 weeks depending on the procedure.
dentalSurgery.faq3A: Yes. All our surgeons hold board certifications and undergo continuous professional development.
dentalSurgery.faq4A: We work with most major insurance providers. Contact us to confirm coverage before your appointment.

braces.heroTitle: Straighten Your Smile, Transform Your Life
braces.heroSubtitle: Certified orthodontists. Cutting-edge aligners and braces. Results you'll see — and feel — for life.
braces.optionsSubtitle: We offer three orthodontic pathways tailored to your lifestyle, budget, and goals.
braces.opt1Desc: Reliable, proven metal or ceramic braces that deliver precise alignment for all complexity levels.
braces.opt2Desc: Nearly invisible custom trays changed every two weeks. Eat, drink and smile without restrictions.
braces.opt3Desc: Braces bonded to the inside of your teeth — completely hidden from view.
braces.ben2: Easier cleaning and better oral hygiene
braces.ben3: Reduced risk of tooth wear and cavities
braces.ben6: Suitable for children, teens and adults
braces.step1Desc: Meet your orthodontist and discuss your goals.
braces.step2Desc: Digital impressions and a customised treatment plan.
braces.step3Desc: Braces or first aligner set fitted by your specialist.
braces.step4Desc: Monthly adjustments to keep treatment on track.
braces.step5Desc: Remove braces, fit retainers, enjoy your new smile.

smileDesign.heroSubtitle: Bespoke smile makeovers crafted by award-winning cosmetic dentists. See life-changing results in as little as one visit.
smileDesign.treatSubtitle: A full menu of cosmetic procedures, individually selected and combined for your unique smile.
smileDesign.t1Desc: Ultra-thin porcelain shells that mask chips, gaps and discolouration for a flawless finish.
smileDesign.t2Desc: Professional-grade bleaching up to 8 shades brighter — in-chair or at-home kits available.
smileDesign.t3Desc: Tooth-coloured resin applied and sculpted to correct chips, cracks or minor gaps.
smileDesign.t4Desc: Laser reshaping of the gum line to create a balanced, symmetrical smile frame.
smileDesign.t5Desc: A bespoke combination of treatments designed around your face, personality and goals.
smileDesign.t6Desc: Preview your new smile digitally before any treatment begins — guaranteed satisfaction.
smileDesign.step1Desc: We study your facial proportions, lip line and tooth colour to design your ideal smile.
smileDesign.step2Desc: See a photorealistic simulation of your new smile before committing to any procedure.
smileDesign.step3Desc: Expert cosmetic procedures carried out in our calm, state-of-the-art clinic.
smileDesign.step4Desc: Reveal your new smile and receive a personalised aftercare plan to protect it.
smileDesign.testi1Text: I cried when I saw my new smile. The team truly understood what I wanted and delivered beyond my expectations.
smileDesign.testi2Text: The digital preview was incredible — I knew exactly what I was getting. The result matched it perfectly.
smileDesign.testi3Text: From the consultation to the reveal, every step felt personalised and professional. Truly world-class.

rootCanal.heroTitle: Save Your Tooth. End the Pain.
rootCanal.heroSubtitle: Modern root canal therapy is comfortable, fast and highly effective. Keep your natural tooth and get back to your life.
rootCanal.benSubtitle: Root canal treatment saves infected teeth and eliminates pain — often in a single appointment.
rootCanal.ben1Desc: Avoid extraction and keep your natural tooth, which is always the best long-term option.
rootCanal.ben2Desc: Most patients feel dramatically better within 24 hours of their root canal treatment.
rootCanal.ben3Desc: The source of infection is removed, protecting surrounding teeth and your overall health.
rootCanal.ben4Desc: A well-treated root canal tooth can last a lifetime with proper dental hygiene.
rootCanal.mythSubtitle: Root canals have an undeserved bad reputation. Here is the truth.
rootCanal.fact1: With modern anaesthesia, most patients report feeling no more discomfort than a routine filling.
rootCanal.myth2: It takes many appointments to complete.
rootCanal.fact2: Most root canals are completed in one or two visits, often in under 90 minutes.
rootCanal.myth3: It is better to just pull the tooth.
rootCanal.fact3: Saving your natural tooth is almost always the best choice for long-term oral health.
rootCanal.step1Desc: Digital X-rays pinpoint the infection and map the root canal system.
rootCanal.step2Desc: Local anaesthetic is applied to ensure you are completely comfortable.
rootCanal.step3Desc: The infected pulp is gently removed and the canals are thoroughly cleaned.
rootCanal.step4Desc: Canals are filled and sealed with biocompatible material to prevent re-infection.
rootCanal.step5Desc: A crown is fitted to restore full strength and function to the treated tooth.

aboutUs.heroTitle: Care That Goes Beyond the Chair
aboutUs.heroSubtitle: For over 15 years, Dr. Muhammed Zain Dental Clinic has been built on one belief: every patient deserves exceptional care in a place they can trust.
aboutUs.missionP1: We opened our doors in 2010 with a simple mission: deliver world-class dental care with genuine compassion. Today, 15 years on, that mission drives every decision we make.
aboutUs.missionP2: From the warmth of our reception team to the precision of our surgeons, every detail is designed around you — your comfort, your goals, your smile.
aboutUs.mis2: Continuous investment in the latest technology
aboutUs.mis3: Transparent pricing with no hidden fees
aboutUs.val1Desc: We treat every patient with empathy and genuine care from the moment they walk in.
aboutUs.val2Desc: Honest treatment recommendations, transparent pricing and no unnecessary procedures.
aboutUs.val3Desc: Board-certified specialists, continuous training and the highest clinical standards.
aboutUs.val4Desc: Deeply rooted in Addis Ababa, we give back and invest in the health of our community.
aboutUs.mile1Desc: Dr. Muhammed Zain opens the clinic with a team of three in central Addis Ababa.
aboutUs.mile2Desc: New surgical suite added to serve growing demand for implants and oral surgery.
aboutUs.mile3Desc: 3D cone-beam CT scanner and digital workflow introduced across all departments.
aboutUs.mile4Desc: Milestone of 15,000 patients treated, cementing our position as the city's leading clinic.
aboutUs.mile5Desc: 12 specialists, 6 treatment rooms and a fully digital clinic serving patients across Ethiopia.

patientStories.heroSubtitle: Real experiences from real people. Discover how our treatments have changed lives — one smile at a time.
patientStories.storiesSubtitle: From nervous first-timers to lifelong patients — every story matters to us.
patientStories.p1Story: I had been hiding my smile for years. After my veneer treatment here, I cannot stop smiling. The team made me feel so comfortable from day one.
patientStories.p2Story: Lost a tooth in an accident and was terrified of implants. Dr. Ravi was so reassuring and the result looks completely natural. Incredible work.
patientStories.p3Story: I was in unbearable pain and called the clinic in a panic. They saw me the same day, the treatment was painless, and the pain vanished overnight.
patientStories.p4Story: Wore aligners for 14 months and the transformation is remarkable. The app to track progress was a great touch. Highly recommend Dr. Lena.
patientStories.p5Story: My teeth went from dull yellow to brilliant white in one hour. The procedure was completely comfortable and the results are stunning.
patientStories.p6Story: This clinic has completely changed my attitude towards dental visits. The staff are warm, the clinic is spotless and I actually look forward to my appointments.

technology.heroTitle: Where Cutting-Edge Tech Meets Expert Care
technology.heroSubtitle: We invest in the most advanced dental technology so your treatment is more accurate, more comfortable and faster than ever before.
technology.techSubtitle: Every piece of equipment is chosen to improve your experience and the accuracy of your treatment.
technology.tech1Desc: Full 3D imaging of teeth, jawbone and airways in one scan — with 60% less radiation than traditional CT.
technology.tech2Desc: Soft-tissue procedures without scalpels, faster healing and near-zero post-op discomfort.
technology.tech3Desc: Simulate your final result on-screen before any procedure begins. No surprises, guaranteed satisfaction.
technology.tech4Desc: Autoclave sterilisation with biological indicator testing ensures 99.9% pathogen elimination.
technology.tech5Desc: Artificial intelligence analyses your scans and assists our doctors in designing the most precise treatment plan.
technology.tech6Desc: High-definition cameras let you see exactly what your dentist sees — full transparency at every visit.
technology.patientTitle: Technology in Service of Your Smile
technology.patientP1: Every technology we invest in has a single purpose: to make your visit safer, more comfortable and more effective. We do not adopt gadgets for the sake of it.
technology.patientP2: From your first scan to your final reveal, our digital workflow means fewer visits, less guesswork and results you can trust.

whitening.heroSubtitle: Professional teeth whitening that is safe, fast and dramatically effective. Up to 8 shades brighter in a single visit.
whitening.optSubtitle: Three proven methods to fit your schedule, sensitivity level and budget.
whitening.opt1Desc: The fastest and most dramatic whitening available. A single 60-minute appointment delivers stunning results.
whitening.opt2Desc: Custom trays and professional-grade gel for gradual whitening at your own pace — brilliant results in 10–14 days.
whitening.opt3Desc: A gentle low-concentration formula designed for sensitive teeth that still delivers meaningful whitening.
whitening.ben4: Long-lasting results with a maintenance plan
whitening.ben5: No tooth damage when done professionally
whitening.ben6: Immediate visible results after one session
whitening.step1Desc: We record your current shade and set a target for your whitening treatment.
whitening.step2Desc: Gums are protected and teeth are cleaned before the whitening agent is applied.
whitening.step3Desc: The whitening gel is activated — by laser light for in-chair, or by wearing trays at home.
whitening.step4Desc: Compare your before-and-after shades and receive tips to maintain your new brilliance.
whitening.faq1A: Professional whitening is safe for enamel. Our products are clinically tested and used under expert supervision.
whitening.faq2A: With good oral hygiene and occasional top-ups, results typically last 1–2 years.
whitening.faq3Q: Is it suitable for sensitive teeth?
whitening.faq3A: Yes. We offer a sensitivity-formulated option and pre-treat with desensitising agents when needed.
whitening.faq4Q: Can I whiten if I have crowns or veneers?
whitening.faq4A: Whitening works on natural enamel only. We will advise if restorations need to be updated to match.
